dashboards.title: shop: jobs
dashboards.description: Every job and cron job of the project: runs, failures, duration and last run per job, from the Kubernetes Job events, plus container restarts, warning events and error logs. Present in deployed environments only. The service selector picks a job by its name, a workload name, a service.name or a run name, on every panel alike.

panels.title: Runs per job
panels.description: Per job over the selected range: runs seen, succeeded and failed, the latest run's start, and run durations (seconds, start to completion). One row per forge job. A run is one Kubernetes Job in one environment, however many pods it created.
panels.sql:
SELECT job,
       count() AS runs,
       countIf(finished > 0) AS succeeded,
       countIf(failed) AS failed,
       max(started) AS last_started,
       tupleElement(argMax(tuple(if(finished > 0 AND started > 0, dateDiff('second', started, finished), NULL)), started), 1) AS last_duration_s,
       if(countIf(finished > 0 AND started > 0) = 0, NULL, round(avgIf(dateDiff('second', started, finished), finished > 0 AND started > 0), 1)) AS avg_duration_s,
       if(countIf(finished > 0 AND started > 0) = 0, NULL, maxIf(dateDiff('second', started, finished), finished > 0 AND started > 0)) AS max_duration_s
FROM (
  SELECT env, run, job, started, finished, failed_at, failure, failed
  FROM (
  SELECT env, run, any(job) AS job,
         minIf(Timestamp, reason = 'SuccessfulCreate') AS started,
         maxIf(Timestamp, reason = 'Completed') AS finished,
         maxIf(Timestamp, reason IN ('BackoffLimitExceeded', 'DeadlineExceeded', 'PodFailurePolicy')) AS failed_at,
         argMaxIf(reason, Timestamp, reason IN ('BackoffLimitExceeded', 'DeadlineExceeded', 'PodFailurePolicy')) AS failure,
         countIf(reason IN ('BackoffLimitExceeded', 'DeadlineExceeded', 'PodFailurePolicy')) > 0 AS failed
  FROM (
    SELECT Timestamp, env, run, uid, job, reason,
           sum(reason = 'SuccessfulCreate' AND prev IN ('Completed', 'BackoffLimitExceeded', 'DeadlineExceeded', 'PodFailurePolicy')) OVER (PARTITION BY env, run, uid ORDER BY Timestamp, ended ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS generation
    FROM (
      SELECT Timestamp, env, run, uid, job, reason, reason IN ('Completed', 'BackoffLimitExceeded', 'DeadlineExceeded', 'PodFailurePolicy') AS ended,
             lagInFrame(reason, 1, '') OVER (PARTITION BY env, run, uid ORDER BY Timestamp, ended ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS prev
      FROM (
WITH [('shop-migrate', ['shop-migrate'], ['shop-migrate']), ('shop-prune', ['shop-prune'], ['shop-prune'])] AS job_identity,
  arrayMap(j -> j.1, if(empty({services:Array(String)}), job_identity,
    arrayFilter(j -> arrayExists(s -> has(j.3, s) OR arrayExists(w -> match(s, concat('^', w, '(-[0-9a-f]{6,12})?$')), j.2), {services:Array(String)}), job_identity))) AS selected_jobs
SELECT Timestamp, ResourceAttributes['reliant.env.id'] AS env, ResourceAttributes['k8s.workload.name'] AS run,
       ResourceAttributes['k8s.object.uid'] AS uid, LogAttributes['k8s.event.reason'] AS reason, tupleElement(arrayFirst(j -> arrayExists(w -> match(ResourceAttributes['k8s.workload.name'], concat('^', w, '(-[0-9a-f]{6,12})?$')), j.2), job_identity), 1) AS job
FROM otel_logs
WHERE Timestamp >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)}
  AND LogAttributes['k8s.event.reason'] IN ('SuccessfulCreate', 'Completed', 'BackoffLimitExceeded', 'DeadlineExceeded', 'PodFailurePolicy')
  AND if(mapContains(LogAttributes, 'k8s.object.kind'), LogAttributes['k8s.object.kind'], ResourceAttributes['k8s.object.kind']) = 'Job'
  AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, ResourceAttributes['reliant.env.id']))
  AND job != '' AND has(selected_jobs, job)
      )
    )
  )
  GROUP BY env, run, uid, generation
  )
)
GROUP BY job
ORDER BY last_started DESC, job

panels.title: Recent runs
panels.description: The newest runs, one row each: job, Kubernetes Job, environment, outcome (Completed, Running, or the failure reason such as BackoffLimitExceeded), start and duration in seconds. A run is one Kubernetes Job in one environment, however many pods it created.
panels.sql:
SELECT job, run, env,
       if(failed, failure, if(finished > 0, 'Completed', 'Running')) AS outcome,
       if(started > 0, toString(started), '') AS started_at,
       if(finished > 0 AND started > 0, dateDiff('second', started, finished), NULL) AS duration_s
FROM (
  SELECT env, run, job, started, finished, failed_at, failure, failed
  FROM (
  SELECT env, run, any(job) AS job,
         minIf(Timestamp, reason = 'SuccessfulCreate') AS started,
         maxIf(Timestamp, reason = 'Completed') AS finished,
         maxIf(Timestamp, reason IN ('BackoffLimitExceeded', 'DeadlineExceeded', 'PodFailurePolicy')) AS failed_at,
         argMaxIf(reason, Timestamp, reason IN ('BackoffLimitExceeded', 'DeadlineExceeded', 'PodFailurePolicy')) AS failure,
         countIf(reason IN ('BackoffLimitExceeded', 'DeadlineExceeded', 'PodFailurePolicy')) > 0 AS failed
  FROM (
    SELECT Timestamp, env, run, uid, job, reason,
           sum(reason = 'SuccessfulCreate' AND prev IN ('Completed', 'BackoffLimitExceeded', 'DeadlineExceeded', 'PodFailurePolicy')) OVER (PARTITION BY env, run, uid ORDER BY Timestamp, ended ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS generation
    FROM (
      SELECT Timestamp, env, run, uid, job, reason, reason IN ('Completed', 'BackoffLimitExceeded', 'DeadlineExceeded', 'PodFailurePolicy') AS ended,
             lagInFrame(reason, 1, '') OVER (PARTITION BY env, run, uid ORDER BY Timestamp, ended ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS prev
      FROM (
WITH [('shop-migrate', ['shop-migrate'], ['shop-migrate']), ('shop-prune', ['shop-prune'], ['shop-prune'])] AS job_identity,
  arrayMap(j -> j.1, if(empty({services:Array(String)}), job_identity,
    arrayFilter(j -> arrayExists(s -> has(j.3, s) OR arrayExists(w -> match(s, concat('^', w, '(-[0-9a-f]{6,12})?$')), j.2), {services:Array(String)}), job_identity))) AS selected_jobs
SELECT Timestamp, ResourceAttributes['reliant.env.id'] AS env, ResourceAttributes['k8s.workload.name'] AS run,
       ResourceAttributes['k8s.object.uid'] AS uid, LogAttributes['k8s.event.reason'] AS reason, tupleElement(arrayFirst(j -> arrayExists(w -> match(ResourceAttributes['k8s.workload.name'], concat('^', w, '(-[0-9a-f]{6,12})?$')), j.2), job_identity), 1) AS job
FROM otel_logs
WHERE Timestamp >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)}
  AND LogAttributes['k8s.event.reason'] IN ('SuccessfulCreate', 'Completed', 'BackoffLimitExceeded', 'DeadlineExceeded', 'PodFailurePolicy')
  AND if(mapContains(LogAttributes, 'k8s.object.kind'), LogAttributes['k8s.object.kind'], ResourceAttributes['k8s.object.kind']) = 'Job'
  AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, ResourceAttributes['reliant.env.id']))
  AND job != '' AND has(selected_jobs, job)
      )
    )
  )
  GROUP BY env, run, uid, generation
  )
)
ORDER BY greatest(started, finished, failed_at) DESC, job, run
LIMIT 50

panels.title: Warning events by job
panels.description: Warning-type Kubernetes events of the jobs, over time, one line per job: the Job's own (a run that hit its backoff limit or deadline) and its pods' (failed image pulls, evictions, failed scheduling, back-offs).
panels.sql:
SELECT toStartOfInterval(Timestamp, toIntervalSecond({step:UInt32})) AS t, job, count() AS warnings
FROM (
WITH [('shop-migrate', ['shop-migrate'], ['shop-migrate']), ('shop-prune', ['shop-prune'], ['shop-prune'])] AS job_identity,
  arrayMap(j -> j.1, if(empty({services:Array(String)}), job_identity,
    arrayFilter(j -> arrayExists(s -> has(j.3, s) OR arrayExists(w -> match(s, concat('^', w, '(-[0-9a-f]{6,12})?$')), j.2), {services:Array(String)}), job_identity))) AS selected_jobs
SELECT Timestamp, tupleElement(arrayFirst(j -> arrayExists(w -> match(ResourceAttributes['k8s.workload.name'], concat('^', w, '(-[0-9a-f]{6,12})?$')), j.2), job_identity), 1) AS job
FROM otel_logs
WHERE Timestamp >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)}
  AND LogAttributes['k8s.event.reason'] != ''
  AND LogAttributes['k8s.event.type'] = 'Warning'
  AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, ResourceAttributes['reliant.env.id']))
  AND job != '' AND has(selected_jobs, job)
)
GROUP BY t, job
ORDER BY t, job

panels.title: Container restarts
panels.description: The highest restart count among each job's containers, one line per job; a step is a restart.
panels.sql:
SELECT toStartOfInterval(Timestamp, toIntervalSecond({step:UInt32})) AS t, job, max(restarts) AS restarts
FROM (
WITH [('shop-migrate', ['shop-migrate'], ['shop-migrate']), ('shop-prune', ['shop-prune'], ['shop-prune'])] AS job_identity,
  arrayMap(j -> j.1, if(empty({services:Array(String)}), job_identity,
    arrayFilter(j -> arrayExists(s -> has(j.3, s) OR arrayExists(w -> match(s, concat('^', w, '(-[0-9a-f]{6,12})?$')), j.2), {services:Array(String)}), job_identity))) AS selected_jobs
SELECT TimeUnix AS Timestamp, Value AS restarts, tupleElement(arrayFirst(j -> arrayExists(w -> match(ResourceAttributes['k8s.workload.name'], concat('^', w, '(-[0-9a-f]{6,12})?$')), j.2), job_identity), 1) AS job
FROM otel_metrics_gauge
WHERE TimeUnix >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND TimeUnix < {to:DateTime64(9)}
  AND MetricName = 'k8s.container.restarts'
  AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, ResourceAttributes['reliant.env.id']))
  AND job != '' AND has(selected_jobs, job)
)
GROUP BY t, job
ORDER BY t, job

panels.title: Error logs
panels.description: The newest error-level log records of the jobs, newest first: job, service, severity, time and message.
panels.sql:
SELECT job, ServiceName AS service, upper(SeverityText) AS severity, toString(Timestamp) AS at, left(Body, 500) AS message
FROM (
WITH [('shop-migrate', ['shop-migrate'], ['shop-migrate']), ('shop-prune', ['shop-prune'], ['shop-prune'])] AS job_identity,
  arrayMap(j -> j.1, if(empty({services:Array(String)}), job_identity,
    arrayFilter(j -> arrayExists(s -> has(j.3, s) OR arrayExists(w -> match(s, concat('^', w, '(-[0-9a-f]{6,12})?$')), j.2), {services:Array(String)}), job_identity))) AS selected_jobs
SELECT Timestamp, ServiceName, SeverityText, Body, tupleElement(arrayFirst(j -> has(j.3, ServiceName), job_identity), 1) AS job
FROM otel_logs
WHERE Timestamp >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)}
  AND upper(SeverityText) IN ('ERROR', 'ERR')
  AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, ResourceAttributes['reliant.env.id']))
  AND job != '' AND has(selected_jobs, job)
)
ORDER BY Timestamp DESC
LIMIT 100

dashboards.title: shop: product usage
dashboards.description: Who uses the product and what they do, from product events: active users, new against returning, weekly retention, the pages people view and the records they create, update and delete. CRUD events are emitted automatically by the generated handlers (signals.product_events = False turns them off); page_viewed comes from the browser runtime. Each headline figure opens beside its change against the previous period. Hosted environments only: a local forge env up has no product_events table.

panels.title: Daily active users
panels.description: Distinct signed-in users with any product event in the 24 hours before the end of the range; the trend is each UTC day's.
panels.sql:
SELECT uniqExact(UserId) AS "Daily active users"
FROM product_events
WHERE UserId != '' AND Timestamp >= {to:DateTime64(9)} - INTERVAL 1 DAY AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, EnvId)) AND (empty({services:Array(String)}) OR has({services:Array(String)}, ServiceName))
panels.trendSql:
SELECT toDate(Timestamp) AS day, uniqExact(UserId) AS "Daily active users"
FROM product_events
WHERE UserId != '' AND Timestamp >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, EnvId)) AND (empty({services:Array(String)}) OR has({services:Array(String)}, ServiceName))
GROUP BY day ORDER BY day

panels.title: Weekly active users
panels.description: Distinct signed-in users with any product event in the 7 days before the end of the range; the trend is the 7 days ending each UTC day.
panels.sql:
SELECT uniqExact(UserId) AS "Weekly active users"
FROM product_events
WHERE UserId != '' AND Timestamp >= {to:DateTime64(9)} - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, EnvId)) AND (empty({services:Array(String)}) OR has({services:Array(String)}, ServiceName))
panels.trendSql:
SELECT addDays(seen, offset) AS day, uniqExact(UserId) AS "Weekly active users"
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT UserId, toDate(Timestamp) AS seen
    FROM product_events
    WHERE UserId != '' AND Timestamp >= toStartOfDay({from:DateTime64(9)}) - INTERVAL 6 DAY AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, EnvId)) AND (empty({services:Array(String)}) OR has({services:Array(String)}, ServiceName))
)
ARRAY JOIN range(7) AS offset
WHERE day >= toDate({from:DateTime64(9)}) AND toDateTime(day) < {to:DateTime64(9)}
GROUP BY day ORDER BY day

panels.title: Monthly active users
panels.description: Distinct signed-in users with any product event in the 30 days before the end of the range; the trend is the 30 days ending each UTC day.
panels.sql:
SELECT uniqExact(UserId) AS "Monthly active users"
FROM product_events
WHERE UserId != '' AND Timestamp >= {to:DateTime64(9)} - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, EnvId)) AND (empty({services:Array(String)}) OR has({services:Array(String)}, ServiceName))
panels.trendSql:
SELECT addDays(seen, offset) AS day, uniqExact(UserId) AS "Monthly active users"
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT UserId, toDate(Timestamp) AS seen
    FROM product_events
    WHERE UserId != '' AND Timestamp >= toStartOfDay({from:DateTime64(9)}) - INTERVAL 29 DAY AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, EnvId)) AND (empty({services:Array(String)}) OR has({services:Array(String)}, ServiceName))
)
ARRAY JOIN range(30) AS offset
WHERE day >= toDate({from:DateTime64(9)}) AND toDateTime(day) < {to:DateTime64(9)}
GROUP BY day ORDER BY day

panels.title: Stickiness (DAU / MAU)
panels.description: The share of the month's active users who were active in the last day: how habitual the product is. The trend is each UTC day's.
panels.sql:
SELECT round(uniqExactIf(UserId, Timestamp >= {to:DateTime64(9)} - INTERVAL 1 DAY) / nullIf(uniqExact(UserId), 0), 4) AS "DAU / MAU"
FROM product_events
WHERE UserId != '' AND Timestamp >= {to:DateTime64(9)} - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, EnvId)) AND (empty({services:Array(String)}) OR has({services:Array(String)}, ServiceName))
panels.trendSql:
SELECT addDays(seen, offset) AS day, round(uniqExactIf(UserId, offset = 0) / nullIf(uniqExact(UserId), 0), 4) AS "DAU / MAU"
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT UserId, toDate(Timestamp) AS seen
    FROM product_events
    WHERE UserId != '' AND Timestamp >= toStartOfDay({from:DateTime64(9)}) - INTERVAL 29 DAY AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, EnvId)) AND (empty({services:Array(String)}) OR has({services:Array(String)}, ServiceName))
)
ARRAY JOIN range(30) AS offset
WHERE day >= toDate({from:DateTime64(9)}) AND toDateTime(day) < {to:DateTime64(9)}
GROUP BY day ORDER BY day

panels.title: New users
panels.description: Signed-in users whose first event (within the 90 days before the end of the range) falls in the range; the trend is each UTC day's.
panels.sql:
SELECT countIf(first_seen >= {from:DateTime64(9)}) AS "New users"
FROM (
    SELECT UserId, min(Timestamp) AS first_seen
    FROM product_events
    WHERE UserId != '' AND Timestamp >= least({from:DateTime64(9)}, {to:DateTime64(9)} - INTERVAL 90 DAY) AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, EnvId)) AND (empty({services:Array(String)}) OR has({services:Array(String)}, ServiceName))
    GROUP BY UserId
)
panels.trendSql:
SELECT toDate(first_seen) AS day, count() AS "New users"
FROM (
    SELECT UserId, min(Timestamp) AS first_seen
    FROM product_events
    WHERE UserId != '' AND Timestamp >= least({from:DateTime64(9)}, {to:DateTime64(9)} - INTERVAL 90 DAY) AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, EnvId)) AND (empty({services:Array(String)}) OR has({services:Array(String)}, ServiceName))
    GROUP BY UserId
)
WHERE first_seen >= {from:DateTime64(9)}
GROUP BY day ORDER BY day

panels.title: Events
panels.description: Every product event in the range, automatic or tracked by the app, signed in or anonymous.
panels.sql:
SELECT count() AS "Events"
FROM product_events
WHERE Timestamp >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, EnvId)) AND (empty({services:Array(String)}) OR has({services:Array(String)}, ServiceName))
panels.trendSql:
SELECT toDate(Timestamp) AS day, count() AS "Events"
FROM product_events
WHERE Timestamp >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, EnvId)) AND (empty({services:Array(String)}) OR has({services:Array(String)}, ServiceName))
GROUP BY day ORDER BY day

panels.title: Events per active user
panels.description: Product events in the range over the signed-in users active in it; the trend is each UTC day's.
panels.sql:
SELECT round(count() / nullIf(uniqExactIf(UserId, UserId != ''), 0), 1) AS "Events per active user"
FROM product_events
WHERE Timestamp >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, EnvId)) AND (empty({services:Array(String)}) OR has({services:Array(String)}, ServiceName))
panels.trendSql:
SELECT toDate(Timestamp) AS day, round(count() / nullIf(uniqExactIf(UserId, UserId != ''), 0), 1) AS "Events per active user"
FROM product_events
WHERE Timestamp >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, EnvId)) AND (empty({services:Array(String)}) OR has({services:Array(String)}, ServiceName))
GROUP BY day ORDER BY day

panels.title: Records written
panels.description: Creates, updates and deletes through the generated CRUD handlers in the range.
panels.sql:
SELECT count() AS "Records written"
FROM product_events
WHERE match(EventName, '_(created|updated|deleted)$') AND Timestamp >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, EnvId)) AND (empty({services:Array(String)}) OR has({services:Array(String)}, ServiceName))
panels.trendSql:
SELECT toDate(Timestamp) AS day, count() AS "Records written"
FROM product_events
WHERE match(EventName, '_(created|updated|deleted)$') AND Timestamp >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, EnvId)) AND (empty({services:Array(String)}) OR has({services:Array(String)}, ServiceName))
GROUP BY day ORDER BY day

panels.title: Active users
panels.description: Distinct signed-in users per UTC day, and over the 7 days ending that day (the rolling weekly active users), drawn as areas.
panels.sql:
SELECT addDays(seen, offset) AS day, uniqExact(UserId) AS "Weekly active (rolling 7 days)",
       uniqExactIf(UserId, offset = 0) AS "Daily active"
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT UserId, toDate(Timestamp) AS seen
    FROM product_events
    WHERE UserId != '' AND Timestamp >= toStartOfDay({from:DateTime64(9)}) - INTERVAL 6 DAY AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, EnvId)) AND (empty({services:Array(String)}) OR has({services:Array(String)}, ServiceName))
)
ARRAY JOIN range(7) AS offset
WHERE day >= toDate({from:DateTime64(9)}) AND toDateTime(day) < {to:DateTime64(9)}
GROUP BY day ORDER BY day

panels.title: New vs returning users per day
panels.description: Each day's active users in exactly one class: new on the day of their first event, returning after it. First-seen is the first event in the 90 days before the end of the range (or since the start of a longer range), so a user idle for longer than that counts as new again on their return.
panels.sql:
SELECT a.day AS day,
       countIf(a.day = f.first_day) AS "New",
       countIf(a.day > f.first_day) AS "Returning"
FROM (
    SELECT toStartOfDay(Timestamp) AS day, UserId
    FROM product_events
    WHERE UserId != '' AND Timestamp >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, EnvId)) AND (empty({services:Array(String)}) OR has({services:Array(String)}, ServiceName))
    GROUP BY day, UserId
) AS a
INNER JOIN (
    SELECT UserId, toStartOfDay(min(Timestamp)) AS first_day
    FROM product_events
    WHERE UserId != '' AND Timestamp >= least({from:DateTime64(9)}, {to:DateTime64(9)} - INTERVAL 90 DAY) AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, EnvId)) AND (empty({services:Array(String)}) OR has({services:Array(String)}, ServiceName))
    GROUP BY UserId
) AS f ON a.UserId = f.UserId
GROUP BY day ORDER BY day

panels.title: Most active users
panels.description: Signed-in users by product events in the range, with the days they were active and when they were last seen.
panels.sql:
SELECT UserId AS "User", count() AS "Events",
       uniqExact(toDate(Timestamp)) AS "Active days",
       uniqExact(EventName) AS "Distinct events",
       formatDateTime(max(Timestamp), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS "Last seen (UTC)"
FROM product_events
WHERE UserId != '' AND Timestamp >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, EnvId)) AND (empty({services:Array(String)}) OR has({services:Array(String)}, ServiceName))
GROUP BY UserId ORDER BY count() DESC, UserId LIMIT 25

panels.title: Records written per entity
panels.description: The automatic CRUD product events (creates, updates and deletes together), one colour per entity, stacked: the top edge is every write.
panels.sql:
SELECT toStartOfInterval(Timestamp, toIntervalSecond({step:UInt32})) AS t,
       replaceRegexpOne(EventName, '_(created|updated|deleted)$', '') AS entity,
       count() AS records
FROM product_events
WHERE match(EventName, '_(created|updated|deleted)$') AND Timestamp >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, EnvId)) AND (empty({services:Array(String)}) OR has({services:Array(String)}, ServiceName))
GROUP BY t, entity ORDER BY t

panels.title: Creates, updates and deletes per entity
panels.description: The CRUD mix of each entity in the range: one bar per entity, a colour per action.
panels.sql:
SELECT replaceRegexpOne(EventName, '_(created|updated|deleted)$', '') AS entity,
       countIf(endsWith(EventName, '_created')) AS "Created",
       countIf(endsWith(EventName, '_updated')) AS "Updated",
       countIf(endsWith(EventName, '_deleted')) AS "Deleted"
FROM product_events
WHERE match(EventName, '_(created|updated|deleted)$') AND Timestamp >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, EnvId)) AND (empty({services:Array(String)}) OR has({services:Array(String)}, ServiceName))
GROUP BY entity ORDER BY count() DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Top pages
panels.description: page_viewed events by route, signed-in views against anonymous ones.
panels.sql:
SELECT Props['route'] AS route,
       countIf(UserId != '') AS "Signed in",
       countIf(UserId = '') AS "Anonymous"
FROM product_events
WHERE EventName = 'page_viewed' AND Timestamp >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, EnvId)) AND (empty({services:Array(String)}) OR has({services:Array(String)}, ServiceName))
GROUP BY route ORDER BY count() DESC LIMIT 15

panels.title: Events by name
panels.description: The most frequent product events in the range, automatic or tracked by the app, signed in against anonymous.
panels.sql:
SELECT EventName AS event,
       countIf(UserId != '') AS "Signed in",
       countIf(UserId = '') AS "Anonymous"
FROM product_events
WHERE Timestamp >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, EnvId)) AND (empty({services:Array(String)}) OR has({services:Array(String)}, ServiceName))
GROUP BY EventName ORDER BY count() DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Weekly retention by cohort
panels.description: One row per weekly cohort: users grouped by the week (Monday, UTC) of their first event, over the 12 weeks before the end of the range (whatever range is selected), with the cohort's size. Each cell is the share of the cohort active again N weeks later (W1 is the week after the cohort's), darker for more. A week that has not happened yet is empty. A user's first event is their first in the 90 days before the end of the range, so one idle for longer joins the cohort of their return.

panels.title: Retention by cohort: weeks 1, 2, 4 and 8
panels.description: For each weekly cohort (users by the Monday, UTC, of their first event, the 12 weeks before the end of the range), the share active again 1, 2, 4 and 8 weeks later. A week that has not happened yet is a gap, not a drop.
